files_modified.description: Replaced initLazyLoadingFallback() with initLazyLoading(). New function: checks native loading='lazy' support; if supported, attaches load event listeners to add 'loaded' CSS class for fade-in; if not supported, uses IntersectionObserver fallback with data-src pattern and 'loaded' class; falls back to eager loading if IntersectionObserver unavailable. Updated init() call site accordingly.

decisions.decision: Process js/main.js modification before creating js/main.min.js
decisions.rationale: The minified file should reflect the final state of the source file including initLazyLoading. Processing in strict order would produce a main.min.js missing the lazy loading function.
The spec calls for initLazyLoading() as the canonical lazy loading initializer. Keeping both would create redundant conflicting functionality.

decisions.decision: Used Node.js one-liner for CSS/JS minification
decisions.rationale: No build tool is installed in this project. Node.js is available without installing dependencies.
